## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.1 — configuration foundation

> **Alpha.** These binaries have not been tested on real hardware beyond a
> Linux development machine. Everything that worked in
> [v0.0.1](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.1) is intended
> to work identically here — but if you want a build that has actually been
> used in anger, stay on v0.0.1.

This is a foundation release, and the honest summary is that **there is almost
nothing new to use yet.** It exists so the work that follows — running only
half the app, listening somewhere other than loopback, authentication — can
land in reviewable pieces on top of a configuration layer that has already
been proven not to change anything.

### What's actually new

- **A configuration file and matching CLI flags.** `~/.config/huemux/app.json`
  plus `--profile`, `--listen-host`, `--listen-port`, `--auth`, `--token`,
  `--tls`, `--tls-cert`, `--tls-key`. Precedence is defaults → file → flags.
- **Startup validation.** A typo'd setting now stops the process with a clear
  message instead of silently falling back to a default.
- **Startup warnings** for configurations that work but probably aren't what
  you meant — binding beyond loopback with no authentication, or sending an
  auth token over plain HTTP.
- **`huemux <typo>` is now an error.** Previously an unrecognised word was
  ignored and the server started anyway.

### What those settings do *not* do yet

**Nothing.** `--profile=lights` is accepted and validated but does not yet stop
the sync engine from starting; `--listen-host` does not yet move the listener
off `127.0.0.1`; `--auth=token` does not yet reject anything. They are wired
through and inert on purpose, so this release is a no-op you can install and
compare against v0.0.1.

The behavior lands in the phases tracked in
[plans/03-execution-phases.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/plans/03-execution-phases.md).

### Also in this release

- **[Design docs for what's next](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/tree/main/plans)** —
  deployment profiles and network access, a standalone Android app
  (`gomobile bind` + WebView, the same trick the Electron build plays), and
  the phase breakdown across both.
- A redesigned [huemux.com](https://huemux.com) with real dark mode and
  zoomable screenshots.
- The release pipeline now runs `go vet` and the test suite before publishing,
  and marks hyphenated tags as pre-releases.

### Known issues

Unchanged from v0.0.1 — see
[KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
The one open item is a Wayland/Electron green preview on first sync, traced to
a system-level PipeWire/GPU issue rather than anything in HueMux.

### Reporting problems

Use the [bug report template](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/issues/new/choose)
and attach a `-debug` log — as of v0.0.1 that single file captures the whole
process's output, including a crash trace, so it's one attachment rather than
a multi-step gather.
